blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Cebuana celebrity Shuvee Etrata has reached another milestone in her showbiz career, celebrating the achievement with her family after purchasing their first family car. In a social media post, Etrata expressed her excitement and gratitude for fulfilling her dream, saying her family could finally experience something they had gone without while she was growing up. “Our first family car. Things we never had growing up, but now get to experience together for the first time,” Etrata wrote in her post.
